title: Barro's PC3 Creator + Workbench + Runtime Proof Studio completion contract

truth_policy.rule: A gate is PASS only when the named command, runtime observation, repository state, or screenshot exists and the evidence is retained. Source presence, mockups, plans, assumptions, or documentation alone never prove runtime behavior.
truth_policy.promotion: The ecosystem may be called 100% complete only when every release_required gate is PASS. BLOCKED and NOT_RUN are not completion.
truth_policy.snapshot_rule: Visual gates require retained screenshots from the actual running application or game. Reference mockups may be compared with them but may not substitute for them.
truth_policy.publication_rule: A repository publication gate passes only after the remote reports the expected commit SHA on the intended branch.

gates.requirement: All 24 RC1 release-required gates PASS
Workbench has a first-class Pizza Creator service client for health, compose/chat, lab, crew, history, reload and STT-capable status without duplicating recipe authority
Workbench agent exposes Pizza Creator actions as real registered tools and reports provider/backend failures without fabricating success
Workbench GUI visibly exposes Pizza Creator connection state and controls while preserving existing Source / Tools+Chat / Output workflow
gates.evidence: running Workbench screenshot + GUI smoke result

gates.requirement: Workbench can open or target the configured Pizza Creator game/runtime/evidence folders using editable configuration
All pre-existing Workbench tests plus new Pizza Creator integration tests pass
gates.evidence: test log retained from clean checkout

layers.name: Runtime Proof Studio Pizza Creator integration

gates.requirement: Studio recognizes the Pizza Creator RC1 contract and can display its gate states without converting NOT_RUN/BLOCKED into PASS
Studio provides a visible Pizza Creator workspace for install/diagnose/proof/evidence actions
Studio can ingest retained RC1 evidence bundles and surface logs, screenshots, result JSON and unresolved blockers
Studio can launch the supported local RC1 proof/diagnostic scripts against an explicitly selected Windows target without modifying Assembly-CSharp.dll
gates.evidence: command construction test + live Windows run evidence

gates.requirement: All pre-existing Studio tests plus new Pizza Creator integration tests pass
gates.evidence: test log retained from clean checkout

gates.requirement: All three repositories agree on target game version/assembly hashes, 87-item catalog facts, runtime bridge method, evidence shortcuts and provider boundary
No project documentation or code claims a mocked, placeholder or unexecuted runtime result as proven
Workbench and Studio link to the same Pizza Creator evidence directory/contract semantics rather than maintaining divergent truth ledgers
Four live in-game Pizza Creator screenshots exist for Chat, AI Lab, Design Crew and Chef Voice and have comparison reports against locked references
Workbench integrated GUI snapshot shows usable Pizza Creator status/control integration with no clipping at the tested resolution
Runtime Proof Studio integrated GUI snapshot shows Pizza Creator contract/evidence workflow with no clipping at the tested resolution
Pizza Creator release ZIP regenerates deterministically and passes manifest/hash/CRC validation
Workbench clean setup/doctor/run/test path succeeds from repository instructions
Studio clean setup/doctor/run/test path succeeds from repository instructions
